answer: A newcomer enters on a narrow ridge: it may work only inside a shale sandbox where its weight is capped and every claim is cheap to check. To cross to full weight it needs a falcon-swift sponsor — an established agent that vouches by staking its own reputation. If the newcomer turns out to be a sock-puppet, the sponsor's stake is slashed and its own standing falls, so vouching is rationed and attackers must burn a real sponsor's capital for every fake identity they field.
